Five Android apps (Java + XML) for the **SaiKet Systems Android Development Internship**, one APK per task:

| APK | Task |
|---|---|
| `Task1_QuizSpark_QuizApp.apk` | Task 1 · Simple Quiz App |
| `Task2_PixelGrid_ImageGallery.apk` | Task 2 · Simple Image Gallery |
| `Task3_ContactBook_ContactsList.apk` | Task 3 · Display List of Contacts |
| `Task4_Relay_ActivitySwitch.apk` | Task 4 · Switch Between Activities |
| `Task5_Tempo_TimerApp.apk` | Task 5 · Simple Timer App |

**Install:** download an APK on an Android 8.0+ phone, open it and allow "Install unknown apps" if Android asks.

All unit tests pass and every app passed its UI test on an Android 14 emulator before this release was built.

Built by J. Risny Suha.
